Third-party files, vendored unmodified so the site works without a build step:

- `mediabunny.min.mjs` — Mediabunny 1.61.3 (MPL-2.0, see `LICENSE-mediabunny.txt`), https://mediabunny.dev
- `mediapipe-vision.mjs` — @mediapipe/tasks-vision 1.1.0 (Apache-2.0), https://github.com/google-ai-edge/mediapipe
  (its WebAssembly runtime is loaded from cdn.jsdelivr.net at the same version)
- `blaze_face_short_range.tflite` — MediaPipe BlazeFace short-range face detector (Apache-2.0)
